capabilities: Import a WhatsApp chat export .zip into the vault
Convert chat messages into Markdown files
Import photo and video attachments into subfolders
Link imported attachments inside the chat notes
Choose the output folder for imported chats
extras: Only .zip exports containing a .txt or .json message file are supported; image captions are only present in Android exports, not iOS.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn WhatsApp chat exports into Markdown notes with their media attachments.
summary: WhatsApp import tool that converts exported WhatsApp chat .zip archives into Markdown notes with linked attachments in a chosen vault folder.
